description: One piece of a stored document's Markdown, never the whole. No section/query: the outline (headings with word counts; full text or abstract only). section: that heading's own text (case-insensitive substring; a repeated heading as "Participants [3/12]"), capped at max_chars, its subsections listed. query: passages holding every term, each a window of at most 1000 chars with its section, best first, at most max_hits (more: how many further passages match); partial: true with missing_terms when no passage holds them all. section and query together: inside that section. A missing paper is added first (added: true).

id.description: ID as "type:value": a paper "pmid:30955454" (bare digits count as pmid) or "doi:10.5812/asjsm.110753" (a paper PubMed does not index; a DOI PubMed indexes is taken as its PMID), a drug label "dailymed:<set ID>" (the set ID from its DailyMed page URL), or a trial record "nct:05173896" (the eight digits; nct:NCT05173896 and a bare NCT05173896 are accepted).

max_chars.description: Cap for section text (default 6000); passages are capped at 1000 chars each regardless.

query.description: Two or three distinctive terms the paper itself would use — a measure and a unit, an outcome and a group, a compound name — not the claim. Passages holding all of them are returned, else the best partial matches. With section: inside that section.

name: library_read
